subject.text: Your reward points are ready to cash out

body.text: One of our staff will call you today.
Tell them the OTP code sent to your phone so your points can be cashed out right away.

explanation: A bank never asks for your OTP, not even by phone, and the domain is nusantarabank-care.test, not nusantarabank.test. A bank OTP is only for transactions you make yourself.
hints: What will the caller ask you for later?
Anyone asking for your OTP is a red flag. Also check the sender's domain.
